title: Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage — Title Brands and Odometer Conditions That Void Coverage
content:
# Title Brands and Odometer Conditions That Void Coverage

Two settings of the Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage name what voids a coverage type: the list of title brands on the vehicle's certificate of title that void it, and whether an altered or inoperative odometer voids it. The title brands recorded on a vehicle are clean, salvage, rebuilt and flood.

| Coverage type | Title brands that void the coverage | Altered or inoperative odometer voids |
|---|---|---|
| Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty | salvage, rebuilt, flood | Yes |
| Factory Complimentary Maintenance | salvage, rebuilt, flood | Yes |
| Factory Basic Limited Warranty | salvage, rebuilt, flood | Yes |
| Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty | salvage, rebuilt, flood | Yes |
| Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty | salvage, rebuilt, flood | Yes |
| Federal Emissions Performance Warranty | salvage, rebuilt, flood | Yes |
| Safety Recall Remedy Coverage | none | No |

## Reading the table by title brand

| Title brand on the vehicle | Coverage types whose list names it |
|---|---|
| clean | none |
| salvage | every coverage type except the Safety Recall Remedy Coverage |
| rebuilt | every coverage type except the Safety Recall Remedy Coverage |
| flood | every coverage type except the Safety Recall Remedy Coverage |

The Safety Recall Remedy Coverage lists no title brand and is not voided by an altered or inoperative odometer.
